klipper-helm bundles the Helm CLI; helm vendors x/crypto/ssh and x/net/html transitively but never invokes them; the `golang.org/x/net/html` package is NOT compiled into the `helm` binary. A pclntab function-table scan of the shipped binary (survives `-s -w` stripping) finds no `golang.org/x/net/html.` symbols (linker dead-code elimination). Verified by direct extraction + symbol scan. Vulnerable code not present.

klipper-helm runs the bundled Helm CLI only against local chart archives and never pushes/pulls charts from an OCI registry, so oras-go's registry-redirect / blob-upload Location credential-forwarding path is never reached. Vulnerable code not in execute path. Fixed upstream in oras-go v2.6.1.

klipper-helm never uses oras-go's file store to materialise OCI content to disk, so the symlink-traversal write-outside-workingDir path is unreachable in this usage. Vulnerable code not in execute path. Fixed upstream in oras-go v2.6.1.

klipper-helm never extracts OCI tar layers via oras-go, so the hardlink tar-extraction directory-escape path is unreachable in this usage. Vulnerable code not in execute path (no fixed oras-go release yet; not exploitable as shipped).
